name: LP-MSPM0G3507 LaunchPad
description: Low-cost LaunchPad for the 80 MHz Cortex-M0+ MSPM0G3507 (128 KB flash, fast 12-bit ADC, op-amp, DAC) with XDS110-class debugger, EnergyTrace and 40-pin BoosterPack headers.
notes: Has three buttons, two LEDs (one RGB), temperature and light sensors, and a buffer to show the 4 MHz ADC. Standard 40-pin BoosterPack headers, not Arduino-compatible.
TI does not show a price on the tool page; $20.56 is a university bookstore price and DigiKey listed $25.70 (backordered). Board size, GPIO count and the connector type are approximate.
